description: He wears a long plum-purple woven outer coat with a high short collar and gold patterned borders along the front, cuffs and hem. Beneath it an ivory tunic shows at the collar and lower edge, decorated with narrow gold vertical trim. A small gold clasp closes the upper chest. A broad gold and brown belt with round medallions and a circular central buckle has a narrow ornamented hanging strap. Brown trousers are tucked into tall brown leather boots. His hands rest behind his back. He has no headgear, armor or weapon.
